status: generated by `cargo xtask rom-symbols` from the standalone listings; curated prose merged by (bank, offset)

addressing: SYS offsets 0x0000-0x3FFF normally appear at CPU addresses 0xC000-0xFFFF.
During reset or explicit paging, SYS can instead appear at CPU addresses 0x0000-0x3FFF.
EXTH offsets 0x0000-0x1FFF appear at CPU addresses 0xE000-0xFFFF.
The BASIC 1.2 system extension occupies EXTH offsets 0x1000-0x1FFF, visible at 0xF000-0xFFFF.
A CPU address alone is not enough to identify a symbol in the 0xF000-0xFFFF range; the active physical bank must also be known.
